display.purpose: Home statement only. Newsreader 400, opsz 72, --fs-display clamp(2.3rem, 5.4vw, 4.9rem) (77.76px at 1440); --fs-display-sm clamp(2.1rem, 9.6vw, 3rem) at <=48rem. Name weight 500; second clause italic in --accent-text.

h2.purpose: Every h2 on every route. Newsreader 400, --fs-h2 clamp(1.5rem, 2.4vw, 1.875rem): 30px at 1440, 24px at 390. Route styles never set an h2 size.

shadows.name: none-on-content

narrative.northStar: Field Notes — a naturalist's notebook kept by an engineer
narrative.overview: One identity: cream paper, ink and a single moss accent, light by default with a warm charcoal dark theme. Newsreader speaks (titles, the home statement), Geist reads and operates (prose, nav), IBM Plex Mono records (dates, counts, EXIF). Engineering and photography share one notebook; the two subjects appear as two voices in one sentence, not two visual systems.
keyCharacteristics: One identity, one accent: moss in both themes, at both ends of every gradient token
Text hierarchy dim < muted < text with a 4.6:1 floor in both themes
Serif/sans/mono voice split; one H2 size (--fs-h2) everywhere
Flat: top hairlines and whitespace, no card boxes or shadows
Truth in details: build-time counts, real EXIF captions, measured contrast

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Moss is the only accent hue in both themes. If a second accent hue appears in chrome, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Whisper Rule
rules.body: Gradients are whispers, never banners: --gradient-hero is none and page-hero glow caps at 0.04-0.05 opacity. No gradient text.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Text never sits on a photograph; contrast comes from tokens, never from photo measurements.

rules.name: The One H2 Rule
rules.body: Every h2 is --fs-h2 (30px at 1440, 24px at 390). Route styles never set an h2 size.

rules.name: The Floor Rule
rules.body: Functional text is at least 0.75rem (12px) and at least 4.6:1 against its ground.

rules.name: The One Edge Rule
rules.body: Header, main and footer share one container inset by --gutter; nothing inside adds inline padding.

dos: Do take every colour, size and font from v2-tokens.scss; add a token there before using a new value.
Do keep dim < muted < text and the 4.6:1 floor in both themes; never use --text-dim on --bg-deep in light (4.19:1).
Do use --accent-text for moss text and --accent-start for moss strokes.
Do compute every count from the collection or manifest the linked page renders.
Do caption photographs with their real title and EXIF; drop missing fields.
donts: Don't reintroduce a dual-identity theme switch or a second accent hue.
Don't set an h2 size in a route stylesheet or a size off the ramp.
Don't load a family other than Geist, Newsreader and IBM Plex Mono, or a weight outside the requested faces.
Don't put text on a photograph or crop a frame to fit a grid.
Don't make the header transparent, blurred, two-row or scroll-aware.
Don't fabricate content, counts, testimonials or EXIF.
